from pathlib import Path
import datetime,json,os,subprocess
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
state={'complete':False,'stage':'functional','supervisorPid':os.getpid(),'errors':[],'noAutomaticRetryFittingOrPromotion':True}
def save():
 state['at']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();f=p/'supervisor-status.tmp';f.write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2)+'\n');f.replace(p/'supervisor-status.json')
save()
try:
 subprocess.run(['python3',str(p/'run.py')],cwd=p,check=True)
 state['stage']='primary-functional-verification';save();subprocess.run(['python3',str(p/'analyze.py')],cwd=p,check=True)
 state['stage']='independent-bun-verification';save();subprocess.run(['nice','-n','19','bun',str(p/'verify.ts')],cwd=p,check=True)
 state['stage']='catalog-prefix-analysis';save();subprocess.run(['nice','-n','19','python3',str(p/'catalog-analyze.py')],cwd=p,check=True)
 state['stage']='independent-catalog-prefix-verification';save();subprocess.run(['nice','-n','19','bun',str(p/'catalog-verify.ts')],cwd=p,check=True)
 result=json.loads((p/'catalog-analysis.json').read_text());verified=json.loads((p/'catalog-independent-verification.json').read_text());assert verified['verificationPassed']and result['passed']==verified['admissionPassed']
 state.update({'complete':True,'stage':'prefix-admission-passed-no-policy'if result['passed']else'prefix-admission-failed-preserve-all','admissionPassed':result['passed']})
except BaseException as error:state['errors'].append(repr(error));state['stage']='failed-preserve-all-records';raise
finally:save()

 if f.name.endswith('-labels.jsonl.gz')or f.name.endswith('-states.jsonl.gz'):continue

   for key in ['inputSha256','traceSha256','score','winner','actualTurns','frames','frameDigest']:
    assert r[key]==first[key],(case['caseId'],epoch,mode,key)

   assert r['quality']['neural']==original['neural']and r['quality']['searchUses']==original['searchUses']and[{k:v for k,v in w.items()if k!='msTotal'}for w in r['quality']['work']]==original['logicalWork']

   assert not r['defaultChanged']and not r['modelFitted']and r['additionalRolloutsRequested']==0
   if mode=='baseline':assert r['labels']==0
   assert r['labelsDigest']==rows[(0,case['caseId'],mode)]['labelsDigest'],('cold labels changed',case['caseId'],mode)

 for line in gzip.open(f,'rt'):
  payload=json.loads(line);epoch,case_id=payload['jobId'].split('/',1);control=rows[(int(epoch),case_id,payload['mode'])]

    assert a['canWait']==expected
   for actual in o['strategyActions']:
    if actual['action']['type']=='wait_turn'and actual['completed']:assert actor['turnLegality']['canWait']
   if int(epoch)!=0:continue
   labels_seen.add((case_id,ordinal));counts['observations']+=1;actor_can_wait[str(actor['turnLegality']['canWait'])]+=1
   sequence[' + '.join(a['type']for a in o['chosenDecision'])]+=1
   roots=o['rootRecords'];assert bool(roots)==(o['rootCatalogStatus']=='searched-root')
   coverage['searched'if roots else'native_only_or_bypass']+=1
   possible=[]
   for root in roots:
    assert root['unitId']==o['unitId']and root['actualTurn']==o['actualTurn']
    for short in root['shortlists']:possible.extend(c['actions']for c in short['input']+short['output'])
    for q in root['queries']:
     assert q['rollouts']>=1 and len(q['candidates'])==len(q['scores'])
     counts['queries']+=1;counts['queries_'+q['mode']]+=1;possible.extend(c['actions']for c in q['candidates'])
     per_candidate=collections.Counter()
     for sample in q['samples']:
      idx=sample['candidateIndex'];assert 0<=idx<len(q['candidates']);per_candidate[idx]+=1
      assert 0<=sample['sampleIndex']<q['rollouts']and sample['mode']==q['mode']and sample['scoreTag']!='thrown'
      assert len(sample['attempts'])<=len(q['candidates'][idx]['actions'])
      for i,attempt in enumerate(sample['attempts']):
       assert attempt['action']['type']==q['candidates'][idx]['actions'][i]['type']and type(attempt['completed'])is bool
       counts['observed_existing_root_action_attempts']+=1
     assert all(v<=q['rollouts']for v in per_candidate.values())
   covered=any(actions==o['chosenDecision']for actions in possible)
   if roots:coverage['actual_choice_in_catalog'if covered else'actual_choice_outside_catalog']+=1
   if roots and not covered:unmatched.append({'caseId':case_id,'ordinal':ordinal,'strategyVersion':o['strategyVersion'],'chosenTypes':[a['type']for a in o['chosenDecision']]})
assert counts['observations']>0 and counts['queries_leaf']>0 and counts['queries_turns']>0
assert actor_can_wait['True']>0 and actor_can_wait['False']>0
assert coverage['actual_choice_in_catalog']>0 and counts['observed_existing_root_action_attempts']>0

 'allOriginalInputsFullTracesOutcomesAndTurnsExact':True,'allCommittedMutableFramesMemoryRngUuidAndIdentityExact':True,
 'allOperationCountersAndNeuralCountsExact':True,'allCanonicalWaitMasksConsistent':True,'allColdLabelDigestsExact':True,
 'countsFirstEpochOnly':dict(counts),'actorCanWaitFirstEpochOnly':dict(actor_can_wait),'chosenSequencesFirstEpochOnly':dict(sequence),
 'catalogCoverageFirstEpochOnly':dict(coverage),'unmatchedActualChoicesFirstEpochOnly':unmatched,'rawFiles':inventory,
 'noOriginalDecisionCatalogOrRolloutsChanged':True,'sourceProfile':'frozen-v11-diagnostic-prefix-replay','currentV12StrengthQualification':False,

   for u in units:

   if r['jobId'].startswith('0/'):
